question: Should the additive QA Plugin SDK surface for selected scenario IDs and group QA targets be accepted as the permanent contract for canonical channel routing scenarios?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but public SDK shape is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision rather than something review automation should silently normalize.

options.title: Accept The Additive Contract
options.body: Proceed after resolving the merge conflict, treating the new QA-only SDK fields as the supported adapter contract for scenario-aware transports.

options.title: Keep It Internal
options.body: Rework the scenario selection plumbing so it stays inside QA Lab internals and does not widen Plugin SDK types.

options.title: Pause For API Design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a broader QA runner adapter options policy.

recommendation.title: Accept The Additive Contract
recommendation.body: Proceed after resolving the merge conflict, treating the new QA-only SDK fields as the supported adapter contract for scenario-aware transports.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa has the strongest recent ownership trail across the canonical QA adapter and Crabline/Matrix transport work touched by this PR.
